findings: Source get_account defaults missing optional account to EMPTY_ACCOUNT. Projecting its code_hash to emptyHash on absence is faithful, provided concrete selector/emptyHash bindings are later supplied.

EMPTY_CODE_HASH is tested before tx/block/pre-state code overlays. Thus an overlay cannot supply nonempty code for an absent account through the empty hash. Present empty accounts remain distinct from absence.
PreState code lookup is an Except callback; load records account read even on callback error. No code availability or successful lookup is invented.
Nonempty successful code fetch proves optional account presence at that exact fetch address without cryptographic injectivity or code-hash preimage assumptions.

fresh_system_owner compares fresh empty-write sibling transactions sharing the same block parent. It does not import throwaway probe reads into execution. This matches the source SYSTEM precheck and fresh execution transaction structure.

Faults excludes missing-owner in all actual dispatcher branches with computed true presence. evaluated_no_owner obtains the same final dispatcher from the actual evaluator, not a separately selected terminal.

code_fetch_no_owner starts evaluation from load(...).2 and so retains account-read metadata; successful nonempty fetch at v.env.codeOwner derives presence and same account-aware projection, then excludes the assertion. No desired assertion-free postcondition supplied.
